questions.q: In a certain code language ‘ROUBST’ is coded as 61. How will ‘FORTUNATE’ be coded in that language?
questions.s:
The logic followed here is :-

Sum of positional value of opposite alphabet - Number of letters in given word.

‘ROUBST’ is coded as 61.

 

Number of letter of word ROUBST = 6

= (9 + 12 + 25 + 6 + 8 + 7) - 6

= 67 - 6

= 61

Similarly,

‘FORTUNATE’ will be coded as :

Number of letters of word FORTUNATE = 9

= (21 + 12 + 9 + 7 + 6 + 13 + 26 + 7 + 22) - 9

= 123 - 9

= 114

Hence, the correct answer is "114".
